entries.description: Authentication-Results names SPF and DMARC as rspamd judged them, beside exim's iprev and DKIM, so a mail client shows spf=pass. One header, not two; without rspamd, or where a mail is not scanned, exim's own line stays as it was. Patched into a file the operator may have edited

A MySQL grant names its database exactly: _ and % in the name were wildcards, so a customer whose name starts another database's name (mys for mysql) got rights on it. Every grant of a database in a record is replaced by the exact one, a suspended database only loses the old grant
